business.description: Nureca Limited is a D2C-first consumer healthcare company with a strong presence in the home healthcare and wellness devices segment, backed by trusted brands such as Dr Trust and Dr Physio. The company operates through digital distribution, customer-centric innovation, and a broad portfolio of affordable, high-quality healthcare products for Indian households.

outlook.statement: India will remain the focus of sales strategy and principal destination for manufacturing capacity. The scale and diversity of the market give substantial room to grow, with immediate priority to deepen penetration, expand distribution and serve more Indian households. Exports will complement domestic business, not define it. Manufacturing investments will be phased in line with category opportunities and consumer demand, prioritising areas where Nureca has strong consumer understanding, established distribution and sustainable right to compete. The company aims to build a globally benchmarked manufacturing platform at Sundran, Punjab, spanning medical devices, consumables, hygiene products and allied categories.

Boosting Quick Commerce Reach and Market Penetration; Driving In-house Manufacturing with Cutting-edge Quality Innovations; Drive Market Growth with New Product Launches and thereby Increase value proposition to customers; Drive Deeper Market Penetration through Enhanced Distribution and New Offline Channels; Expand and Enrich Omni-channel Integration.

Based on future projections approved by the management and various initiative taken to increase the overall business, the holding company expects future taxable profit against which the deferred tax asset is expected to be recovered in the future.
